name: Horseless Carriage - mechanically-enforced gate trajectories
description: Scripted single-turn conversations checking that the live agent team's tool-call trajectory respects HC's code-level enforcement gates (protected-branch push guard, story-pipeline ordering/ownership, human-approval gates, no-virtual-key budget block, mandatory-retro sprint-report gate) - see eval/adk/README.md for how this complements docs/EVALUATION.md's end-to-end scenario harness, and its known limitations around exact tool-call argument matching against live LLM output.
